items.name: Truffle Parmesan Hand-Cut Fries
items.description: Crispy golden potatoes tossed with Italian black truffle oil, freshly grated aged parmesan, and fresh rosemary with garlic aioli dip.

items.name: Firecracker Glazed Wings
items.description: Crispy chicken wings glazed in a spicy sweet chili honey glaze, topped with toasted sesame seeds and scallions.

items.name: Creamy Burrata Caprese Crostini
items.description: Imported creamy burrata over toasted artisanal sourdough, heirloom cherry tomatoes, basil pesto, and balsamic glaze reduction.

items.name: The Grand Wagyu Smash Burger
items.description: Double smash Australian wagyu patties, melted Vermont sharp cheddar, caramelized onions, secret smoky bistro sauce on toasted brioche.

items.name: Smoked Paneer Tikka Bowl
items.description: Clay oven charred cottage cheese cubes marinated in aromatic tandoori spices, served over saffron basmati rice with mint raita.

items.name: Pan-Seared Atlantic Salmon
items.description: Crispy skin Atlantic salmon filet served with whipped garlic mash, roasted asparagus spears, and lemon caper butter reduction.

items.name: Wild Truffle & Mushroom Pizza
items.description: Hand-stretched 48-hour fermented Neapolitan dough, fior di latte mozzarella, roasted cremini & shiitake mushrooms, truffle cream.

items.name: Spicy Pepperoni & Hot Honey Pizza
items.description: San Marzano tomato base, cupping pepperoni, fresh mozzarella, finished with chili flakes and a generous drizzle of hot Mike's honey.

items.name: Passionfruit Mint Sparkler Mocktail
items.description: Fresh passionfruit pulp, crushed garden mint, fresh lime juice, organic agave, topped with sparkling Perrier.

items.name: Smoked Bourbon Old Fashioned
items.description: Kentucky straight bourbon, Angostura bitters, pure cane sugar cube, expressed orange peel, smoked with French oak wood chips.

items.name: Warm Belgian Molten Lava Cake
items.description: Warm dark Valrhona chocolate cake with an oozing rich chocolate center, paired with Madagascar vanilla bean ice cream.

items.name: Classic New York Berry Cheesecake
items.description: Velvety smooth Philadelphia cream cheese filling over buttery Graham cracker crust, topped with fresh raspberry compote.
